target.title: fix(codex): bound Computer Use process inspection
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with Codex Computer Use auto-repair enabled could have startup readiness or periodic health checks hang indefinitely when macOS process inspection (`/bin/ps`) stopped responding.

## Why This Change Was Made

The plugin now bounds its scoped process listing to two seconds through the existing `runExec` timeout contract. Listing failures remain fail-closed: no Computer Use child is terminated without a complete process snapshot and verified ancestry. The focused test keeps this failure boundary covered. This PR is AI-assisted and was independently reviewed twice.

## User Impact

Codex Computer Use setup and health checks can recover from a hung process-list command instead of waiting forever. On timeout, repair reports a warning, leaves processes untouched, and the existing retry path continues.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/computer-use.test.ts` - 33 tests passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check extensions/codex/src/app-server/computer-use.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/computer-use.test.ts` - passed.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --type-aware --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error extensions/codex/src/app-server/computer-use.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/computer-use.test.ts` - passed.
- `git diff --check origin/main...HEAD` - passed.
- Directly inspected the OpenClaw process timeout contract at `src/process/exec.ts:33-65` and Execa timeout/termination behavior in `node_modules/execa/lib/terminate/timeout.js:11-20` and `node_modules/execa/lib/terminate/kill.js:70-92`.
- Directly inspected sibling Codex HEAD `5c19155cbd93bfa099016e7487259f61669823ff`:
  - `../codex/codex-rs/cli/src/main.rs:1100-1151`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs:676-691`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs:954-974`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/app-server/src/lib.rs:1114-1150`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/app-server-transport/src/transport/stdio.rs:24-100`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs:1043-1068`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/core/src/thread_manager.rs:898-947`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/core/src/session/handlers.rs:599-617`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/core/src/session/handlers.rs:631-670`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/codex-mcp/src/connection_manager.rs:398-411`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/codex-mcp/src/rmcp_client.rs:495-503`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/rmcp-client/src/rmcp_client.rs:736-749`
  - `../codex/codex-rs/core/src/spawn.rs:82-125`

- Secretless `macos-15` baseline/candidate proof: [workflow run 29670136124](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/actions/runs/29670136124). The matrix checked immutable candidate `615c816133b6c897eee27530c02e6808593a3465` and its direct parent `f3fcea0cde3df7d17b17769b965a634d1c9451e5`.
  - A normal real `/bin/ps -axo pid=,ppid=,command=` completed in 154 ms with no warning or termination.
  - With only that observed `ps` child stopped by `SIGSTOP`, the parent remained stalled until the 6,026 ms outer watchdog. The candidate instead emitted its configured timeout warning and recovered in 2,009 ms without watchdog intervention.
  - In both lanes, the matching Computer Use child stayed alive at retry, `killedPids` remained empty, the stopped `ps` was reaped, and the existing retry path completed on attempt 2 (`threadStarts=2`, `toolCalls=2`).
